# Example Product

> One-sentence description of what this is and who it's for.

Short intro paragraph. What problem this solves, what's notable about the approach, and how this site is organized. Keep this to 2-4 sentences — agents use it to decide whether to continue fetching.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://example.com/docs/quickstart.md): Get running in 5 minutes
- [Core concepts](https://example.com/docs/concepts.md): Mental model and architecture
- [API reference](https://example.com/docs/api.md): Full endpoint list with schemas
- [Authentication](https://example.com/docs/auth.md): OAuth 2.1 setup and token flows
- [Webhooks](https://example.com/docs/webhooks.md): Event types, delivery, signature verification

## Examples

- [Auth flow](https://example.com/examples/auth.md): Complete OAuth 2.1 walkthrough in Python and TypeScript
- [Webhook handler](https://example.com/examples/webhooks.md): Verifying signatures and handling retries
- [Batch operations](https://example.com/examples/batch.md): Efficient bulk inserts and updates

- [Python](https://example.com/sdks/python.md): `example-sdk` on PyPI
- [Go](https://example.com/sdks/go.md): `github.com/example/go-sdk`
